title: Animate the Lighthouse Just Made
tests: Tests resolving a follow-up to the previously generated picture and animating it rather than creating an unrelated scene.

faults.what: The scene looks predominantly photographic or digitally rendered rather than watercolor; characteristic translucent washes and watercolor texture are not visibly maintained.
The sweeping beam appears to originate near the red balcony below the lantern room rather than from the lighthouse lamp.

judge.summary: The dusk lighthouse scene shows moving surf and a sweeping beam, but the requested watercolor appearance is not convincing.

must_haves.item: The final deliverable is a playable 6-second landscape video in 16:9.
must_haves.why: The supplied samples are labeled as frames from a six-second MP4 and are landscape, but still images cannot establish playback or verify the exact encoded aspect ratio.

must_haves.item: The lighthouse's red-and-white stripes, rocky coastline and composition visibly correspond to the first-turn picture.
must_haves.why: The striped lighthouse and rocky coast remain consistent across the supplied frames, but the first-turn picture is not provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The watercolor appearance and dusk lighting remain visible throughout.
must_haves.why: Pastel dusk lighting persists, but the detailed rocks, water and lighthouse have a predominantly photographic/rendered appearance rather than a clear watercolor treatment.

must_haves.item: Waves visibly move against the rocks and a lighthouse beam sweeps across the water.
must_haves.why: Wave crests and foam change around the rocks between frames, and the beam appears and shifts outward over the water.

must_haves.item: There is no added writing or audible sound.
must_haves.why: No writing is visible in any supplied frame, but audio cannot be assessed from still images.
